title: Customer request: FP8/INT8 quantization exemption + bespoke calibration workflow for high-sensitivity model
creator: Maya Chen
description: Support ticket from a regulated customer asking for a temporary exemption from default INT8/FP8 rollout for a mission-critical NLU model and an engineered, auditable bespoke calibration run. Customer reports that after automated quantization the model shows intermittent regressions on a narrow set of high-priority intents. They want: (1) an audited calibration job using their labeled holdout, (2) a build artifact pinned to a non-quantized or selectively-quantized model variant for up to 30 days, and (3) documented validation metrics and acceptance criteria to allow safe re-enablement of platform optimizations. Engineering must provide a reproducible workflow, artifact storage, traceable PRs, and a rollback path.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Run complete with deterministic config and seed; artifacts stored in S3 and drive. 2) Evaluation report comparing FP16 vs INT8 vs FP8 with agreed metrics (intent accuracy, exact match, avg token logprob) and visual diffs for top failure cases. 3) Quantization exemption artifact (model bundle and runtime config) produced and deployed to customer's Dedicated pool behind a feature flag. 4) Customer signoff in writing and follow-up plan (re-run cadence or permanent exemption) recorded in ticket. 5) All PRs reviewed and merged; rollout limited by policy and audited in console.
run_plan: Step 0: Triage + collect dataset and replay tokens from customer (redaction/sampling applied). Step 1: Create ephemeral dedicated job (g4dn-equivalent) isolated network and storage for their onprem-like constraints. Step 2: Use repo toolchain to produce three quant variants: full-FP16 baseline, global-INT8, layerwise-FP8 hybrid. Step 3: Run calibration with deterministic random seed and config (seed=20250218, num_calib_batches=1024, shard=0..3) and save KV cache snapshots. Step 4: Evaluate on customer-provided labeled holdout and platform eval harness (intent accuracy, EM, mean token logprob, BLEU/ROUGE on generative tasks as applicable). Step 5: Produce HTML report and attach artifacts. Step 6: If delta<=tolerance: produce signed model bundle and enable limited rollout; else: generate mitigation recommendations (selective layer exclusion, bias-correction, or keep FP16).
tolerance_criteria: Absolute intent-accuracy drop <= 0.5% OR relative drop <= 2% AND no catastrophic fail cases in top-100 queries. Token-level logprob mean change <= 0.03. Any high-confidence misclassification flagged for manual review.
rollback_plan: 1) Re-pin runtime route to customer to FP16 bundle stored in artifact registry. 2) Remove the quantized variant from routing rules and notify customer and SRE. 3) Run ephemeral validation to confirm behavior restored. 4) Log incident and schedule follow-up with Research to improve quant ops.
comments: 2025-02-18 Maya Chen: Created ticket after SRE escalated from Support (#SUP-1880). Customer provided a 12k example labeled holdout and a replay log of recent traffic. Marked high customer_impact.

2025-02-19 Ravi Patel: Initial analysis shows larger regression concentrated in two transformer layers that have heavy activation ranges. Hypothesis: quant scale overflow in per-channel min-max for those layers. Planning a layerwise FP fallback test.

2025-02-20 QA (Aisha Gomez): Completed deterministic baseline runs for FP16 and INT8 on a 2k subset. Observed intent accuracy drop 1.8% for INT8, FP8 hybrid shows 0.9% drop. Collected top-40 failure examples and uploaded to S3.

2025-02-21 Research (Liam O'Connor): Ran layerwise sensitivity sweep (script: tools/quant/sensitivity_sweep.py). Two candidates identified for exclusion from quantization (layers 7 and 9). Adding selective-quant config to PR.
2025-02-22 Ravi Patel: Opened PR runtime#3124 with selective-layer-quantization toggle and deterministic calibration harness. Requesting review from Research and Security for artifact handling.
2025-02-24 PM (Elena Ruiz): Confirmed customer wants a 30-day exemption window if hybrid approach meets tolerance. Customer asks for weekly re-evaluation and a final rollback threshold defined above.

2025-02-25 Support (Jin Park): Customer validated sample report and accepted initial hybrid build for staging deployment. Added requirement: include per-token attention heatmaps for top-10 failure cases.
2025-02-26 Code review: runtime#3124 approved by Research, ops#428 requires minor infra creds handling change. Scheduling deployment to dedicated staging pool tomorrow.
2025-02-27 Ravi Patel: Running full calibration with num_calib_batches=4096 across 4 shards (job id: calib-7542-20250227). Expected artifact generation by EOD PST.
notes: Do not expose raw customer PII in public artifacts. All S3 links above are in a private bucket with restricted IAM groups.
Consider adding automated regression gating to console rollout path: prevent enabling quant variants if any customer in cohort reports >0.5% absolute accuracy drop after calibration.
Follow-up: build an internal playbook for support-driven quant exemptions to reduce ad-hoc engineering burden.
